identity.note: The registry's own decorated-aka guard reads this name as a normalized substring match against scottie-vai. Recorded distinct, not merged: the only record this entity has is a placing in the RSPWF Top 200, which gives a ring name and a federation tag and nothing else — no dates, no roster, no URL, so three of the collision doctrine's own four signals are simply absent and the no-merge default holds. Every held-promotion roster the ranked names were checked against came back with zero overlap. Reopenable the moment either side gains a record the other can be checked against.
